newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African wool prices mixed at latest auction.
newsitem.headline: S.African wool prices mixed at latest auction.

text.p: South African wool prices were mixed at the last weekly auction, the Wool Board said.
It said 12,999 bales were offered at this week's sale, of which 97.1 percent was sold.

Price quotes for long Merino fleeces of 20 micron fell 0.2 percent, 21 micron rose 2.2 percent, 22 micron fell 0.2 percent, 23 micron rose 3.0 percent, 24 micron rose 2.3 percent and 25 micron rose 2.3 percent.
Prices for Merino bellies rose 1.1 percent, Merino lambs fell 2.7 percent and Merino locks fell 1.2 percent.
The offering included 1,800 bales of other White Wools, 1,110 bales of Ciskei/Transkei, 2,127 bales of Lesotho and 1,190 bales of coarse and coloured.

Of the 459 bales of 20 micron offered, 95.4 percent was sold. Of the 1,272 bales of 21 micron offered, 97.3 percent was sold. Of the 1,791 bales of 22 micron offered, 96.8 percent was sold. Of the 1,363 bales of 23 micron offered, 99.2 percent was sold. Of the 694 bales of 24 micron offered, 98.6 percent was sold and of the 268 bales of 25 micron offered, 98.1 percent was sold.
The next sale will take place in August, when about 10,000 bales will be on offer.
